original_prompt.global_prompt: Five short kitchen shots retain the man's oven interactions and waiting gestures, followed by a wide dining shot with the same man and a white cat.

shots.text: In an amber-and-teal kitchen, the plaid-shirt man stands left of a pale built-in oven beside a glowing rounded archway. He has short dark hair, black rectangular glasses, a moustache with light stubble, a dark ear stud, a dark-and-white plaid shirt, narrow dark tie and wristwatch. Begin with him bent forward, arms inside the open oven. He withdraws his arms, raises the bottom-hinged glass door until it closes, then bends to peer through its window. Retain the medium side view and warm archway behind him throughout the five seconds.

The plaid-shirt man remains bent close to the closed built-in oven in the orange-lit kitchen. His glasses and face are seen in tight profile, with the pale handle and glowing window on the right. Over five seconds he briefly brings his hands together near his wristwatch, lowers them, and raises his face slightly while continuing to look toward the oven.

Beside the same closed built-in oven, the plaid-shirt man stands upright with the amber archway behind him and pale cabinetry above the appliance. He briefly holds his hands together, reaches to grasp one round oven control, then releases it and lowers his arm. Keep his attention on the appliance and let this small interaction occupy five seconds.

The plaid-shirt man leans toward the closed oven window, amber light filling the archway behind his teal-shadowed profile. His hands are held near his chest with the round watch visible beneath them. Across five seconds he shifts his clasped fingers and gently rubs his palms together, keeping his eyes toward the oven.

A close side view holds the plaid-shirt man's glasses and intent profile opposite the closed built-in oven window. With his torso bent forward and the orange kitchen glowing behind him, he peers through the glass for five seconds, making only slight head movements and briefly parting his lips.

In a wide, steady view of a warmly lit dining area, the same plaid-shirt man sits at the left end of a wooden dining table, working with a dining knife and fork over a light-centered, dark-rimmed plate. A short-haired white cat with a raised curved tail walks across the tabletop toward the right-front edge, lowers its head and forequarters over the edge and disappears below the tabletop out of view. The man continues at his plate, then brings a forkful toward his open mouth. A drinking glass, broad-leaf potted plant and clear fruit bowl furnish the table; a radiator is behind it and a glowing dark-shaded lamp fills the right foreground. Complete the sequence in five seconds.
